name: Minato Bridge
facts: Minato Bridge, unveiled in 1974, carries Osaka’s Hanshin Expressway Route 16 Osakako Line on its upper deck and Route 5 Bayshore Line below, linking bustling city arteries.
Standing as the world’s third-longest cantilever truss span, Minato Bridge follows only Quebec Bridge and the Forth Bridge in sheer length and engineering ambition.

Engineers abandoned arch and suspension designs after discovering alternating clay and gravel layers, opting instead for a high‑strength steel cantilever that dramatically cuts mass and suits Osaka’s tricky subsoil.
